freehit.why: Playing it this week projects +7.4 xP over your current XI (greedy best-affordable-squad estimate on weak xP, not a proven optimum). The certain cost is the copy itself: expires after GW19, next copy unlocks GW20. Whether +7.4 now beats saving it for a worse week is your call. The 2 xP bar is a judgement line, not calibrated.

bboost.why: Bench projects only 8.7 xP this week - weak week for it. Expires after GW19.

3xc.why: Best starter projects 5.4 xP - no standout week. A double gameweek is the classic spot; none is flagged in this horizon. Expires after GW19.

calls.leanWhy: More moves, hits if needed leads the horizon by +43.40 xP net of certain costs. Weak signal: this orders the options, it does not make the call. This plan re-optimises every future week on today's frozen data, so its edge compounds model error - it is the least certain number on the page, and most of its moves are future weeks you will re-decide with better information.

plans.cost: Foregoes any fix this week. The cost is the best fix you did not make - shown on the other cards.

fh_baseline: free-hit uplift is measured against the engine's best feasible XI under formation, bench budget and club-cap constraints (45.56 xP), NOT against the user's picked XI, which is unknowable before the deadline.
scoring_rule: After GW9 completes: fetch actual points per player from the official API.
